provenance.title: Glass Light Toggle by Zsolt Kacso
provenance.oracle: Official JavaScript executed in a Node VM, independently of the Dart implementation. Only measured numerical outputs are retained.
provenance.random_initialization: Math.random replaced by a 32-bit LCG with multiplier 1664525 and increment 1013904223; output is unsigned state divided by 2^32.
provenance.initial_frame: Frame 0 is sampled at time 0 with dt 0; later frames advance by 1/60 second.
provenance.coordinate_system: Design pixels relative to the scene centre; x and y are the original output minus viewport centre (360, 260).
provenance.scope: Verifies source-model numerical equivalence under a chosen deterministic seed. The recording seed and input history remain unknown; this fixture does not establish pixel-identical replay of the recording.
